dedupe_keys.name: taar pirminiai duomenys raw data apie arestuojamas keliu transporto priemones

description: TAAR pirminiai duomenys (raw data) apie areštuojamas kelių transporto priemones is a dataset listed in data.gov.lt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Valstybės įmonė Registrų centras. Depersonalized data (RAW DATA) of the register of asset seizure acts on impounded road vehicles, property type and subtype, their statuses of asset seizure acts, registration/deregistration dates. The geographical sample of the data is the entire territory of the country. Coverage: Valstybės įmonė Registrų centras. The portal shows the English title as "TAAR primary data (raw data) on impounded road vehicles" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Valstybės įmonė Registrų centras. Its keywords include Registras, Automobilis, Taar, Registrų Centras. The listing shows 6 download or service links in CSV, JSON. The listing shows 2025-12-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.lt). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-lt.
